questions.q: Who wrote the first Nagraj comic book?
questions.why: Parshuram Sharma scripted the first Nagraj comic, with Pratap Mullick on art.
Nagraj is one of Raj Comics' flagship heroes.

questions.q: What does Nagraj use as ropes, shields and messengers?
questions.why: Nagraj carries microscopic snakes that he can shape into tools and carriers.

questions.q: Which fellow hero from the same publisher is Nagraj's best friend?
questions.why: Dhruva and Nagraj are closest allies, and they team up often in specials.

questions.q: Which king is Nagraj's biological father in the origin story?
questions.why: Nagraj was born to King Takshakraj and Queen Lalita in Takshaknagar.

questions.q: Which uncle tampered with an offering at Nagraj's birth, leaving him cast into a river?
questions.why: His uncle Nagpasha tampered with an offering, and the baby was presumed dead.

questions.q: Who raises Nagraj and uses him as a weapon in his debut story?
questions.why: Nagmani, a scientist, is both foster father and first villain.
Pratap Mullick drew the debut issue, working from the first script.

questions.q: Who conceived Nagraj along with his sons?
questions.why: Rajkumar Gupta, founder of Raj Comics, and his sons came up with the snake hero.

questions.q: On which channel did Nagraj's animated films air in India in 2015?
questions.why: Cartoon Network India broadcast three of the five animated films in 2015.
